trail.summary: Sjuhäradsleden runs from Hindås through Bollebygd, Borås and Ulricehamn to Mullsjö. It crosses forest, agricultural landscapes and towns, is divided into 10 official stages, and is described by tourism sources as part of Europaled 1 in Sweden.

notes: Naturkartan stage pages observed during the overview pass list Västra Götalands län even for the trail guide/stages; the route end is in Mullsjö kommun, Jönköpings län.
Borås Stad states that stages 3-6 are wholly or partly in Borås and that the Borås portion is 47 km.

endpointCoordinates.caveat: Borås also lists 'Start etapp 3' at converted [57.6889068, 12.6987323]; section research must verify whether this is a parking/access point, map-label artifact, or true section-boundary ambiguity.

officialSectionOrder.geometryCaveat: Overview GPX audit found one simplification step over 500 m, max gap 838.6 m; section synthesis should decide if the GPX is navigation-grade or only planning-grade.

endpointCoordinates.caveat: Borås Stad line shows Böne kyrka as 6416620 4120226 on stage 8, likely an extra-digit typo; stage 9 and GPX support 6416620 412026.

officialSectionOrder.name: Sjuhäradsleden, etapp 10
officialSectionOrder.connectorContext: Borås and tourism sources describe the end at Hotell Mullsjö as a continuation point toward Västra Vätterleden / Södra Vätterleden context.

branchesLoopsAlternatesConnectors.description: Stage 10 follows Södra Vätterleden for the final roughly 6 km toward Mullsjö according to Borås/Naturkartan stage text.
Stage 8 is described by Borås Stad as partly belonging to Åsundenleden and Redvägsleden.

Västsverige notes Vildmarksleden context from Årås and Västra Vätternleden continuation at Mullsjö; section research should model these only as context unless official connector geometry is needed later.

campingAndLodging: Västsverige says there are multiple rest and overnight options along the trail, including hostels, hotels, scenic rest stops, and some fixed wind shelters.
Hindåsgården is mentioned as a good early-start overnight option near Hindås.
Borås Camping is mentioned near stage 5 for hostel/cabin overnighting.
Prångens Camping is an official stage endpoint at stage 7/8.
Årås Säteri & Trädgårdar is a service/overnight context near stages 9/10.
Hotell Mullsjö is the official end context for stage 10.
fireAndShelter: Borås lists grill places at Hestrastugan, Kypesjön badplatsen, Källeberg, Nordtorp, Sjöbo Rydastrand, Sjöbo Åland, Sjöbovallen and Skidstadion.
Borås lists a wind shelter at Kypesjön badplatsen.
Stage-level research must verify exact coordinates, rules, seasonality and whether each should be imported as a facility, access metadata, or pending.
water: No whole-trail potable-water guarantee found during overview pass.
Section research must distinguish commercial/service taps from natural water, toilet sinks, lakes/streams, and unverified sources.
parkingTransit: Borås says parking exists at several places along the trail and directs users to stage start points; per-stage pages list nearest bus stops for several stages.
Transit network is primarily Västtrafik through Västra Götaland sections, with Jönköpings län/Mullsjö context at the northern end; section-level access must use current stop/operator sources.

qualityAssurance.summary: Naturkartan says the whole Sjuhäradsleden has not yet been fully quality-assured by Västkuststiftelsen and that the trail generally has shortcomings in signage, passability and similar areas.

privateLand.summary: Borås PDF text for stage maps notes that the trail runs largely over private land and asks hikers to keep nature clean and respect landowners' agriculture, hunting and fishing.

fire.summary: Use only prepared fire places where fires are allowed, and check current fire-ban information before relying on fire/grill facilities.
fire.researchNeed: Section rules/safety agents must attach local fire-ban authority/operator URLs and protected-area-specific restrictions.

dogsLivestockHunting.summary: Stage 7 text warns that the route passes grazing pastures and asks hikers to close gates and avoid frightening animals. Hunting/landowner rights are explicitly mentioned in Borås PDF text.

accessibility.summary: Borås Stad states the trail is not accessibility-adapted.

gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.detail: Naturkartan's current warning about lack of full quality assurance is significant and may affect import confidence, especially if user-facing app text implies a fully maintained trail.
gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.nextAction: Rules/safety lane must verify whether Västkuststiftelsen has newer quality-assurance or closure/reroute information.

gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.detail: Borås publishes rounded official distances, while Naturkartan and computed GPX lengths differ for stages 1, 2, 9 and 10. Use official rounded distances for planning display but keep measured GPX lengths for QA.
gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.nextAction: Per-section synthesis should choose display distance and preserve source contradiction notes.

gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.detail: Borås lists Hestrafors IF, IK Omega and 'Start etapp 3'; section 2 and 3 synthesis found GPX stage 2 ends and stage 3 starts near IK Omega, while the converted 'Start etapp 3'/Omegastugan access coordinate is about 1.1-1.15 km south.
gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.nextAction: Use IK Omega as the route boundary for normalization review and model Omegastugan/Olsfors as access metadata unless a trail manager confirms different semantics.

gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.detail: Section 4 synthesis found Naturkartan GPX continuity endpoints differ by about 186-200 m from Borås/OSM access coordinates at both SOK-stugan and Rya åsar. Naturkartan joins adjacent sections cleanly, while Borås/OSM appear closer to practical access clusters.
gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.nextAction: Use Naturkartan GPX vertices for route continuity and model SOK-stugan/Nordtorp and Rya åsar/Björbobacken/Björbostugan as access/facility metadata unless the normalizer intentionally prioritizes access endpoints.

gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.topic: Stage 5 route geometry and access-coordinate offsets
gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.detail: Section 5 synthesis found Naturkartan GPX and Västsverige Google My Maps KML match closely and are primary geometry candidates. OSM relation 4177360 is connected but reversed, about 0.441 km longer, and endpoint-divergent. Rya åsar access coordinate differs about 186 m from Naturkartan start; Karlsaflogarna official/OSM points differ about 54-160 m from Naturkartan end.
gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.nextAction: Use Naturkartan GPX / Västsverige KML for route continuity, use OSM as cross-check only after reversing, and model Rya åsar/Karlsaflogarna access/facilities separately.

gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.topic: Stage 6 geometry, access and water caveats
gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.detail: Section 6 synthesis found correct Karlsaflogarna-to-Blackered endpoints in Naturkartan GPX/API, but raw Naturkartan/Västsverige linework includes duplicate/parallel/spur artifacts around Rölle. Blackered direct transit is weak, Komskälet may be a stale stop reference, and Raska-Minas spring/grill/cup-mark coordinates remain unresolved.
gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.nextAction: Normalize Rölle geometry before import, verify Blackered/Komskälet access in the live Västtrafik planner, and verify Raska-Minas water/facility coordinates before exposing them.

gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.topic: Stage 7 geometry, Prången endpoint and Blackered access caveats
gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.detail: Section 7 synthesis found an 838.6 m simplified chord in Naturkartan/Västsverige geometry requiring densification, a 255 m difference between the Naturkartan route endpoint and the Borås/KML Prångens Camping access coordinate, weak Blackered public transport, and a stale Komskälet/Kommskälet stop reference.
gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.nextAction: Densify section 7 geometry before import, model Prångens route endpoint and campsite access separately, suppress Komskälet until live Västtrafik verification, and deduplicate Prångens endpoint facilities.

gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.detail: Borås stage 8 line appears to include an extra digit in the easting for Böne kyrka; stage 9 and GPX support the shorter coordinate.
gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.nextAction: Verify in section 8 and 9 synthesis before writing final endpoint coordinates.

gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.topic: Stage 8 Böne coordinate, Jordkulan water and endpoint caveats
gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.detail: Section 8 synthesis resolved the Böne stage-8 easting as a typo: use 412026, not 4120226. Remaining import caveats include three-part Naturkartan GPX structure, Prångens/Böne access-cluster semantics, Jordkulan overnight/water reliability, non-potable Böne water and weak Böne transit.
gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.nextAction: Use corrected Böne coordinate, model Prångens and Böne access clusters separately, verify Jordkulan shelter/water maintenance, suppress Böne/Jordkulan potable-water claims and verify Dalum/Närtrafik access before import.

gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.detail: Borås uses Årås säteri; OSM/E1/PDF and local Årås sources use Årås kvarn; tourism source describes Årås Säteri & Trädgårdar and old mill context. Section 9 synthesis recommends Årås säteri as official section label with Årås kvarn and Årås Säteri & Trädgårdar as endpoint aliases.
gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.nextAction: Use the same alias/deduplication policy in section 10 so the Årås endpoint cluster is not duplicated.

gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.topic: Stage 9 Årås protected-area, service and access caveats
gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.detail: Section 9 synthesis found strong Naturkartan/OSM geometry and official source coverage, but fixed-route transit is weak at both Böne and Årås, public potable water is not confirmed, Årås cafe/lodging are seasonal/customer-dependent, and Struntfiskeboa firepit/overnight use needs reserve-boundary and rules verification because Årås reserve prohibits fires.
gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.nextAction: Model Böne and Årås route endpoints separately from access/service clusters, use Närtrafik only as pre-booked weekday access metadata, suppress public potable water, and clip Struntfiskeboa/Årås facilities against protected-area rules before import.

gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.detail: The legacy vandraisjuharad.se link on OSM wiki and the Skaraborgsleder/Mullsjö page appear older. They should not override Borås/Naturkartan/Västsverige current data.
gapsContradictionsAndStaleRisks.nextAction: Use older sources only as supporting context and mark accessed/revision dates.
